objective: Add an owner-triggered Electron desktop capture path that lists bounded screen/window previews through opaque short-lived grants, captures the complete selected source in the main process, downsizes it to an explicit 640/960/1280-pixel long-edge preset before submission, and optionally runs the existing GPU OCR or configured vision provider without automatic capture or default pixel persistence.
non_goals: Do not crop, redact, mask or otherwise omit part of the owner-selected source.
Do not add continuous capture, background polling, game automation or model-triggered capture.
Do not persist source lists, previews, source identifiers or snapshot pixels in Electron.
Do not expose DesktopCapturerSource IDs, filesystem, process or network primitives to the sandboxed renderer.
Do not add a new image model, dependency, release benchmark, soak test or open another product module.
contracts: Only the operator window may enumerate or capture desktop sources.
The renderer receives an opaque UUID source token and bounded preview, never the Electron source ID.
A capture grant expires after at most 60 seconds and is single-use.
Every snapshot requires an owner click, owner confirmation header and the existing perception.observe safety feature flag.
The full selected source is preserved compositionally while its long edge is reduced to exactly one allowlisted maximum: 640, 960 or 1280 pixels.
PNG submitted to the loopback control plane remains at or below 1 MiB and uses source owner.desktop.
OCR/VLM output remains untrusted, decisionSupportEligible=false and bounded by the existing observation TTL of at most 15 seconds.
Normal capture does not persist source metadata, preview pixels or snapshot pixels.
allowed_dependencies: Electron 43 desktopCapturer and NativeImage APIs already pinned in the workspace
Vue 3 already pinned in the workspace
oss_candidates: No new dependency; use the pinned Electron desktopCapturer.getSources and NativeImage resize/toPNG APIs documented by Electron.
acceptance_criteria: The desktop Quan sát page lists real screen/window previews after an explicit owner action and does not expose raw DesktopCapturerSource IDs.
The owner can select 640, 960 or 1280 pixels with 960 as the default, then submit one full-frame PNG through the existing perception route.
The page clearly states that the complete selected source is sent and that lower resolution reduces payload and image-processing cost.
Optional OCR and configured vision analysis flags reach the runtime only when selected.
The perception feature flag can be explicitly enabled or disabled from the operator page through the existing safety control plane.
Capture grants reject unknown, expired and reused tokens; malformed input and non-operator IPC fail closed.
Fast desktop build, typecheck, unit tests, workspace check and a real Electron startup/page smoke pass.
